SELECT ug.grade_id AS gradeId, e.id AS exam_id, e.title AS exam_title, g.grade_name, MAX(ues.user_score) AS max_score, MIN(ues.user_score) AS min_score, AVG(ues.user_score) AS avg_score, COUNT(ues.user_id) AS attendNum FROM t_exam e JOIN t_exam_grade ug ON e.id = ug.exam_id JOIN t_user_exams_score ues ON e.id = ues.exam_id and ues.state = 1 JOIN t_user u ON ues.user_id = u.id JOIN t_user_grade userGrade ON userGrade.u_id = u.id AND userGrade.g_id = ug.grade_id AND (userGrade.is_deleted = 0 OR userGrade.is_deleted IS NULL) JOIN t_grade g ON ug.grade_id = g.id
e.is_deleted = 0 and ues.user_id IS NOT NULL
and ug.grade_id = #{gradeId}
and e.title like concat('%',#{examTitle},'%')
and g.id in
#{uId}
GROUP BY ug.grade_id, e.id, e.title

select ues.id,u.id as userId ,e.title, u.real_name, ues.user_time, ues.user_score, ues.limit_time, ues.count,e.id as examId from t_user_exams_score as ues join t_user as u on ues.user_id = u.id join t_user_grade as userGrade on userGrade.u_id = u.id and userGrade.g_id = #{gradeId} and (userGrade.is_deleted = 0 or userGrade.is_deleted is null) join t_exam as e on ues.exam_id = e.id
ues.exam_id = #{examId} and ues.state = 1
and u.real_name like concat('%',#{realName},'%')

select u.id as userId, u.real_name as userName, e.title as examTitle, ues.limit_time as limitTime, ues.exam_id as examId, ues.whether_mark as whetherMark, case ues.whether_mark when 1 then '已阅卷' when 0 then '待阅卷' else '无需阅卷' end as corrected from t_user_exams_score as ues left join t_user as u on ues.user_id = u.id left join t_exam as e on ues.exam_id = e.id where ues.exam_id = #{examId} and ues.state = 1 and ues.whether_mark in (0, 1)
and u.real_name like concat('%',#{realName},'%')
order by ues.whether_mark asc, ues.limit_time desc

select ues.exam_id as examId, u.id as userId, e.title as examTitle, u.real_name as userName, g.grade_name as gradeName, ues.create_time as createTime, ues.limit_time as limitTime, ues.user_time as userTime, ues.user_score as userScore, ues.whether_mark as whetherMark from t_user_exams_score ues left join t_user u on ues.user_id = u.id left join t_grade g on u.grade_id = g.id left join t_exam e on ues.exam_id = e.id where ues.exam_id = #{examId} and ues.user_id = #{userId} limit 1
